actions.name: Find emails
actions.description: Searches your mail, newest first, with plain fields Fabric turns into one Gmail search (each value is matched as written, never read as a search operator). It returns up to maxResults messages a page, each with its sender, subject, date, snippet and labels, and nextPageToken for the next page. Mail in Trash and Spam is left out.

from.description: Words or an address the From line holds.

to.description: Words or an address the To line holds.

label.description: A label name or id the messages carry.

words.description: A phrase anywhere in the message.

hasAttachment.description: true for messages with an attachment, false for those without.

after.description: Only messages from this instant on, RFC 3339 with its offset.

before.description: Only messages before this instant, RFC 3339 with its offset.

maxResults.description: How many messages a page holds, 1 to 25.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Read email
actions.description: Reads one message: its sender, recipients, subject, date and labels, its plain text (or, when it has none, its HTML as text), each cut at 100,000 characters, and its attachments by name, type and size. Attachments are never fetched.

messageId.description: The message id, as Find emails or Read email gives it.

actions.name: Read conversation
actions.description: Reads one conversation, oldest message first: each message's sender, subject, date and plain text, cut at 2,000 characters. A conversation of more than 50 messages is refused; Read email reads any one of them, and its HTML when it has no plain text.

threadId.description: The conversation id (threadId), as Find emails or Read email gives it.

actions.name: Send email
actions.description: Sends a new plain-text email from your own address. To, Cc and Bcc take plain addresses, at most 100 each, and nobody else receives it: it never sets a reply-to address, a display name or an attachment. The card shows every recipient and the whole text.

to.description: The addresses the email goes to: plain addresses, at most 100.

cc.description: The addresses copied: plain addresses, at most 100.

bcc.description: The addresses copied without the others seeing them: plain addresses, at most 100.

text.description: The plain text of the email, at most 10,000 characters.

actions.name: Reply
actions.description: Replies in plain text to one message, in its conversation. It goes to the message's Reply-To, or its sender when there is none; with replyAll it also goes to everyone the message was sent and copied to, never back to you. The card shows every recipient.

messageId.description: The message to reply to, as Find emails or Read email gives it.

replyAll.description: true to reply to everyone the message was sent and copied to as well.

text.description: The plain text of the email, at most 10,000 characters.

actions.name: Create draft
actions.description: Saves a new plain-text draft from your own address, which Fabric records as made by it, so Edit draft can change it later without asking again. To, Cc and Bcc take plain addresses, at most 100 each. Nothing is sent.

to.description: The addresses the email goes to: plain addresses, at most 100.

cc.description: The addresses copied: plain addresses, at most 100.

bcc.description: The addresses copied without the others seeing them: plain addresses, at most 100.

text.description: The plain text of the email, at most 10,000 characters.

actions.name: Edit draft
actions.description: Replaces a draft's whole message with a new plain-text one from your own address: the card shows the draft's headers now beside the new message. It runs without asking only on a draft Fabric made; any other draft asks first. The new message starts its own conversation. Nothing is sent.

draftId.description: The draft id, as Create draft gives it.

to.description: The addresses the email goes to: plain addresses, at most 100.

cc.description: The addresses copied: plain addresses, at most 100.

bcc.description: The addresses copied without the others seeing them: plain addresses, at most 100.

text.description: The plain text of the email, at most 10,000 characters.

actions.name: Send draft
actions.description: Sends a draft exactly as Fabric read it for the card, which shows the whole message as it will be sent: every header (Bcc and Reply-To included), so every recipient, the subject, each part and the attachments by name, and the plain text decoded (cut at 10,000 characters there). A change made to the draft after the card was shown is not sent. A draft the card cannot show whole (over 50,000 characters) is refused, as is a draft with no plain text.

draftId.description: The draft id, as Create draft gives it.

actions.name: Organize email
actions.description: Adds and removes labels on up to 25 messages, or on every message of one conversation: removing INBOX archives, removing UNREAD marks as read. Labels are names or ids of labels you have; SENT, DRAFT, TRASH and SPAM are refused (use Move to trash or restore), and an unknown name is refused rather than created.

target.description: messages takes messageIds; thread takes threadId and changes every message of the conversation.

messageIds.description: The messages, as Find emails gives them.

threadId.description: The conversation id (threadId), as Find emails or Read email gives it.

addLabels.description: Label names or ids to add; [] for none.

removeLabels.description: Label names or ids to remove; [] for none.

actions.name: Create label
actions.description: Finds the label with this name, in any letter case, or creates it when there is none, and returns its id; created is true only when it made the label. It never makes a second label that differs only in case.

actions.name: Move to trash or restore
actions.description: Moves one message, or every message of one conversation, to Trash, or restores it from Trash. Gmail deletes mail in Trash for good after 30 days, so restore it before then. It never deletes anything itself.

move.description: trash-message or restore-message take messageId; trash-thread or restore-thread take threadId.

messageId.description: The message id, as Find emails or Read email gives it.

threadId.description: The conversation id (threadId), as Find emails or Read email gives it.

expr.const: Gmail deletes mail in Trash for good after 30 days.

actions.name: Set out-of-office reply
actions.description: Turns your automatic reply off, or on for a time window with a subject and plain text, for your contacts only or for everyone who writes. Off takes nothing else; on takes contactsOnly, subject, text, start and end (RFC 3339 instants with their offset, the start before the end).

enable.description: true turns the reply on, false turns it off.

contactsOnly.description: true replies only to people in your contacts; false to everyone who writes.

text.description: The reply's plain text, at most 10,000 characters.

start.description: When the reply starts, RFC 3339 with its offset.

end.description: When the reply ends, RFC 3339 with its offset.

const:
on
contactsOnly
subject
text
start
end

actions.name: Auto-label incoming mail
actions.description: Makes a Gmail filter that adds one of your labels to new mail from one address. It never forwards, deletes or archives mail; SENT, DRAFT, TRASH and SPAM are refused. "Delete drafts, labels or filters" removes the filter.

label.description: A label name or id of a label you have.

expr.const: Delete the filter under "Delete drafts, labels or filters".
